_doc: Small free-text vocabularies retained for quest-record parsing and non-canon evidence filtering. Entity/card admission uses source-native target-page evidence in pipeline.discovery.entity_typing; this file intentionally contains no article-title, race/species, person, location-type, or entity-classification lists.

quest_alliance_binding_tokens._why_no_structural_signal: Faction binding is read from Questbox wikitext, which is free text.

quest_horde_binding_tokens._why_no_structural_signal: Faction binding is read from Questbox wikitext, which is free text.

entry_quest_title_keywords._why_no_structural_signal: Chain heads are structural; this only prefers a player-facing breadcrumb among otherwise equivalent heads.

non_canon_body_markers._why_no_structural_signal: These filter non-canon evidence body text, not linked entity identity.
